text:
Stars are powered by nuclear reactions that release energy.
Which statement describes the nuclear reaction in stable stars?
A
Nuclear fission converts helium into hydrogen.
B
Nuclear fission converts hydrogen into helium.
C
Nuclear fusion converts helium into hydrogen.
D
Nuclear fusion converts hydrogen into helium.

options.label: A
options.text: Nuclear fission converts helium into hydrogen.

options.label: B
options.text: Nuclear fission converts hydrogen into helium.

options.label: C
options.text: Nuclear fusion converts helium into hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: Nuclear fusion converts hydrogen into helium.
